## Checklist
- [ ] `bun run typecheck`, `bun run lint` and `bun run test` pass
- [ ] Follows the ground rules in CONTRIBUTING.md (official thresholds, no invented data, honest dates, read-only public API)
- [ ] New migration is additive. `scripts/export-db.sh` re-run if the schema or setup data changed
- [ ] No secrets or personal data
- [ ] Docs updated
